lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Giovanna de Fátima | Lesson 5 -- Ten Minutes About Me
lesson.grammar_point: questions with verb to be (Are you...? / Is it...? / Where are you from?)

listenings.text: Hi Giovanna, it is Daniel. Are you free on Friday? We are ready to close the report, and the team is here until six. Is your part finished? If you are busy in the morning, the afternoon is fine for me. Call me when you can. Thank you.

This is my weekend. On Saturday I am free. I do not work. In the morning I am at home with my boyfriend, and in the afternoon we are together at the cinema. On Sunday I am busy: I clean the house and I cook. On Sunday night I am tired, but I am ready for Monday.

extra_audio.text: Giovanna is busy from Monday to Friday. On Saturday she is free. She goes out with her boyfriend. They are together at the cinema. On Sunday night she is ready for a new week.
